# moodle-cli 0.5.1

## Summary

This patch fixes the npm package artifact for the TypeScript CLI.

## Fixes

- Include `dist/moodle.js` in the published npm package so the `moodle` binary works after `npm i -g moodle-cli`.
- Add a package-content check to CI and release workflows so a release fails before publish if the npm tarball is missing the CLI bundle.
- Make the release workflow idempotent for already-published npm versions and runnable manually for an existing tag.

## Validation

Validated with:

- `npm run check`
- `npm test`
- `npm run build`
- `npm run pack:check`
